title: Claude Code
description: Cost, tokens, productivity, API/tool performance, traces and events for local Claude Code sessions.

panels.title: API errors
panels.description: api_error events in the range. A healthy API has none, so any error is flagged.

panels.title: Failed MCP servers
panels.description: MCP servers that failed to connect (per session start). A healthy setup has none.

panels.title: Tool failure rate vs usual
panels.description: Share of tool calls that failed now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x. Lightly smoothed (+1/+2) so a single failure early on does not explode the ratio.

targets.expr: ((((sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" [$__range])) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" [$__range])) or vector(0)) + 2)) / (((sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" [7d])) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" [7d])) or vector(0)) + 2)))

panels.title: Cache hit rate vs usual
panels.description: Cache hit share now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange below 0.9x, red below 0.75x of usual. Low means prompts are being re-read at full price.

panels.title: API latency p95 vs usual
panels.description: p95 request duration now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by () / quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [7d]) by ()

panels.title: Time to first token p95 vs usual
panels.description: p95 time to first token now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap ttft_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by () / quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap ttft_ms | __error__="" [7d]) by ()

panels.title: Cost per request vs usual
panels.description: Average cost of an API request now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x. Rises when context grows or a pricier model is used.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" [$__range]))) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [7d])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" [7d])))

panels.title: 5-hour limit used
panels.description: Share of the rolling 5-hour limit used.

panels.title: 5-hour pace
panels.description: Used so far divided by the part of the window already gone, i.e. where this window ends if you keep the current pace. Orange from 85%; red above 100% (you would hit the limit before it resets). Early in a window it is unreliable.

panels.title: Weekly limit used
panels.description: Share of the 7-day limit used (all models).

panels.title: Weekly pace
panels.description: Used so far divided by the part of the window already gone, i.e. where this window ends if you keep the current pace. Orange from 85%; red above 100% (you would hit the limit before it resets). Early in a window it is unreliable.

panels.title: Limit usage over time
panels.description: Utilization of each limit as reported by the usage endpoint; the 5-hour line drops back to 0 when its window resets.

panels.title: Weekly usage by product
panels.description: Share of this week's usage by product (Claude Code, Chats, Cowork, ...).

panels.title: Weekly limits by model
panels.description: Separate weekly limits for specific models, when your plan has them.

panels.title: Credits used
panels.description: Usage credits spent beyond your plan limits (currency as reported by your account).

panels.title: Credits
panels.description: Whether usage credits are switched on. When off, hitting a limit stops requests.

panels.title: Unnamed allowance
panels.description: A dollar allowance the usage endpoint returns under an internal name (iguana_necktie); its meaning is not documented. Amount used so far.

panels.title: Cap
panels.description: Limit of the unnamed allowance to the left.

panels.title: Usage data age
panels.description: Time since the last successful usage poll (it runs every 4 minutes). Orange after 10 minutes, red after 25: usually an expired login token (it refreshes when Claude Code is used) or rate limiting.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Per-session counters: totals use max_over_time per series over the selected range, so a session that started before the range includes its earlier usage.

panels.title: Prompts
panels.description: Prompts you sent (user_prompt events).

panels.title: Active time
panels.description: Time actively working (you + Claude).

panels.title: Total cost
panels.description: Per-session counters: totals use max_over_time per series over the selected range, so a session that started before the range includes its earlier usage.

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Per-session counters: totals use max_over_time per series over the selected range, so a session that started before the range includes its earlier usage.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: cacheRead / (cacheRead + input + cacheCreation). Higher = cheaper and faster.

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: api_request events.

panels.title: API p95 latency
panels.description: p95 request duration across all models.

panels.title: Tool success rate
panels.description: Share of tool calls that succeeded.

panels.title: Lines
panels.description: Lines added + removed by Claude's edits.

panels.title: PRs
panels.description: Pull requests created.

panels.title: Cost per hour by model
panels.description: Exact spend per interval, summed from api_request events (cost_usd). Shown as a rate per hour, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Tokens per minute by type
panels.description: Exact tokens per interval from api_request events. Shown as a rate per min, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Cost by query source
panels.description: main = your prompts; other values are sub-agents and background queries.

panels.title: Top sessions by cost
panels.description: Session = first 8 characters of the session id.

panels.title: Cost per API request (avg)
panels.description: Average cost_usd per request, by model.

panels.title: Lines added vs removed
panels.description: Lines changed by Claude's edits in the selected range.

panels.title: Edit decisions
panels.description: Permission decisions for Edit, Write and NotebookEdit.

panels.title: Edit accept rate
panels.description: Share of edit permission prompts accepted.

panels.title: Prompts per hour
panels.description: How often you prompt (user_prompt events). Shown as a rate per hour, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Activity share by type
panels.description: Share of time spent active, summed over sessions (above 100% means several sessions at once). user = you typing/reading; cli = Claude working.

panels.title: Sessions started per hour
panels.description: Sessions that began in each interval (fresh / continue / resume). Shown as a rate per hour, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: API latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Dashed lines: your own p95 over the last 7 days, and 1.5x that (where the Health tile turns orange).

panels.title: Time to first token p50 / p95
panels.description: Dashed lines: your own p95 over the last 7 days, and 1.5x that (where the Health tile turns orange).

panels.title: API requests per minute
panels.description: Shown as a rate per min, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Requests by effort and speed
panels.description: Reasoning effort and speed setting (e.g. fast mode) per request.

panels.title: API errors per hour
panels.description: api_error / api_retries_exhausted events. Empty while the API is healthy (verified: a bad model name produces an HTTP 404 here). Shown as a rate per hour, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Tool calls per minute
panels.description: Shown as a rate per min, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Tool failures per hour
panels.description: tool_result events with success=false. Shown as a rate per hour, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Permission decisions per minute
panels.description: accept/reject and who decided (config, user, hook ...). Shown as a rate per min, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Permission mode and auto-mode verdicts
panels.description: Permission mode in force and the auto-mode classifier's verdict per tool call.

panels.title: Tool result size p95 by tool
panels.description: Large results fill the context window; watch for tools that return a lot.

panels.title: MCP server connections
panels.description: mcp_server_connection events in the range. 'failed' means a configured server did not start.

panels.title: Skills activated
panels.description: Skills loaded, and whether you or Claude triggered them.

panels.title: Subagent runs by type
panels.description: subagent_completed events: which subagents ran, and on which model.

panels.title: Subagent duration (avg)
panels.description: Wall-clock time per subagent run.

panels.title: Subagent tokens per run (avg)
panels.description: Total tokens a subagent used (counted separately from the main conversation).

panels.title: Span rate by type
panels.description: interaction = one prompt; llm_request = one API call; tool / tool.execution / tool.blocked_on_user. The binary also defines mcp.rpc, hook, subagent.spawn, compaction and bash.subprocess spans, but they were not exported in testing; they would show up here if emitted.

panels.title: Span errors per hour
panels.description: Error spans per interval; empty is good. Shown as a rate per hour, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Recent interactions (click a trace ID to open the waterfall)
Slow LLM requests (over 3 s, slowest first)

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "claude-code" && name = "claude_code.llm_request" && duration > 3s } | select(span.model, span.ttft_ms, span.output_tokens)

panels.title: Slow tool calls (over 1 s, slowest first)
panels.description: Whole tool call, including any time spent waiting for a permission answer.

panels.title: Events per minute by type
panels.description: plugin_loaded is excluded; it fires many times at every startup. Shown as a rate per min, so the scale is the same at every time range.

panels.title: Plugins loaded
panels.description: Plugins Claude Code loaded in the range (one load per session start).

panels.title: Event stream (prompt text is redacted by default)
